description: This file defines the interface 'DittoProtocolSub' which specifies subscription management methods for Ditto protocol channels, including subscribing, unsubscribing, updating subscriptions, managing acknowledgement labels, and creating instances for actor systems.

classes.name: DittoProtocolSub
classes.description: Interface for managing Ditto protocol subscriptions and acknowledgements.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes a subscriber to specified streaming types and topics, returning a future indicating success or failure.

methods.name: removeSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a subscriber from the subscription list.

methods.name: updateLiveSubscriptions
methods.description: Updates the active streaming types for a subscriber and manages their topics, returning a future.

methods.name: removeTwinSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a subscriber from the twin events channel, returning a future.

methods.name: declareAcknowledgementLabels
methods.description: Declares acknowledgement labels for a subscriber, ensuring uniqueness and returning a future.

methods.name: removeAcknowledgementLabelDeclaration
methods.description: Removes acknowledgement label declarations for a subscriber.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DittoProtocolSub for a given ActorContext.
